examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Determinant of a 2x2 Matrix With Non-Integer Entries
examples.worked_solution:
For a $2 \times 2$ matrix, the determinant is given by the formula

$$
|\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}|
$$

Using the formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & =|\begin{aligned}\sqrt{2} & -2 \\ 0 & \sqrt{3}\end{aligned}| \\  & =\sqrt{2}\cdot \sqrt{3}-(-2)\cdot 0 \\  & =\sqrt{6}\end{aligned}
$$
